## Specific task description

Task instruction: Pick up the microphone used for audio input and transfer it to the other hand.

Task description: This round's target is the silver-mesh, black-handle microphone on the right side of the table. Pick it up and hand it from the right hand to the left hand.

Success criteria: Move the microphone left of the robot centerline and lift it to an airborne handover height about twenty centimeters above the table or higher. The left gripper must be closed and actually touching and holding it; the right must be open and released.

## Execution tips

- The right hand can grasp a straight section of the black handle near its tail that fits the pads, avoiding the very end. Leave the section near the silver mesh head for the left hand to reduce gripper interference during handover.
- Close the fingers across the handle's long axis, with the opening slightly wider than the selected section. Before closing, confirm that the pads are on opposite sides of the handle rather than merely overlapping in the image while pushing it or closing on empty space.
- During the handoff, keep the right hand supporting the microphone. Release it only after the left pads securely grip the reserved section of the handle to avoid dropping it during an unsupported midair transfer.
